description: Search negbit's live catalog of OKF knowledge bundles. Omit all args to browse the full catalog. `query` matches (case-insensitive substring) the id, title, and pitch. `domain` is an extra keyword narrowing the same text (negbit's catalog has no formal per-bundle domain field — it is treated as an additional filter, not a taxonomy lookup). Returns each match with title, id@version, price (USD + micro-USDC), one-line pitch, short sha256, preview URL, and security verdict.

domain.description: Extra keyword filter (matched against bundle text; not a formal taxonomy).

name: search_bundles
title: Search negbit bundles
